title: Calibration Department Measure: Delay Days of a Held-Up Customer-Pay Repair (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Measure.** For the delay goodwill credit on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, the delay days are measured from the repair's calibration order where the network's own calibration held the repair: where the order's first in-house attempt failed and the order was sublet to a dealer, they are the days from that first attempt to the completion date, counted as the difference between the two dates; where the first in-house attempt failed and a later in-house attempt passed, they are the days from the first attempt to the passing attempt, counted the same way; otherwise they are the business days by which the repair overran its target. The credited delay days are the delay days but no more than the goodwill authority days.

The business days by which the repair overran its target are the business days (Monday to Friday) after the repair start date, up to and including the ready date, less the target turnaround of the repair's service tier under Customer-Pay Repairs, never below zero.

## Records read

The repair's calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations (opened for the customer-pay repair order the rental is tied to): the date and result of its first in-house attempt, the date of its passing attempt, its dealer sublet and its completion date.

## Measure by what the calibration order shows

| First in-house attempt | Later events on the order | Delay days |
|---|---|---|
| Failed | Sublet to a dealer, with a completion date | Completion date less first attempt date, in days |
| Failed | Not that, but a later in-house attempt passed | Passing attempt date less first attempt date, in days |
| Any other case, or no calibration order | | The business-day overrun of the repair |

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates)

- First attempt failed on the 4th, order sublet, dealer completed it on the 11th: 7 delay days.
- First attempt failed on the 4th, second in-house attempt passed on the 6th: 2 delay days.
- First attempt passed on the 4th; the repair started on a Monday and was ready on the Friday of the next week against a target of 6 business days: 9 business days less 6, so 3 delay days.
